description: This file defines classes and functions for multi-channel software PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) generation, including configuration, initialization, and control of PWM signals in embedded systems.

classes.name: PwmConfig
classes.description: Class representing multi-channel software PWM configuration and control.

classes.name: SimplePwm
classes.description: Derived class for simple PWM with specific duty cycle control.

methods.name: PwmConfig
methods.description: Constructor initializing PWM with switch times and wave configurations.

methods.name: setFrequency
methods.description: Sets the PWM frequency; uses NAN to pause PWM.

methods.name: handleCycleStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a PWM cycle.
